_readme: MANUALLY MAINTAINED. These are official Nigerian economic indicators, NOT live or real-time market data, and no API supplies them. Every figure below was checked against the named official source on the date in lastVerified. Read public/data/README.md before editing, then update reportingPeriod and lastVerified for every figure you touch. Never publish a rate that has not been verified against the official publication: Starfetch is a regulated firm's public website.

indicators.label: Headline Inflation
indicators.note: Consumer price inflation, year on year. Fifth consecutive monthly decline and a six-year low. The CPI reference index rose to 147.0 points (base 2024 = 100).
indicators.publicationReference: NBS Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, October 2026, published 16 November 2026

indicators.label: Monetary Policy Rate
indicators.note: The CBN's benchmark interest rate, cut by 350 basis points from 26.5% at the 307th MPC meeting, the largest single reduction since 2006.
indicators.publicationReference: CBN communiqué of the 307th Monetary Policy Committee meeting, 21-22 September 2026

indicators.label: Cash Reserve Ratio
indicators.note: Reserve requirement for deposit money banks. Left unchanged at the 307th MPC meeting.
indicators.publicationReference: CBN communiqué of the 307th Monetary Policy Committee meeting, 21-22 September 2026

updateProcess: See public/data/README.md. Short version: confirm the figure on the official NBS or CBN publication, update value/reportingPeriod/previousValue/previousPeriod/publicationReference and lastVerified, then commit and deploy.
disclaimer: Official Nigerian economic indicators, published by the NBS and the CBN. They are updated by hand when a new official release is published, so they are not live and may lag the most recent release by a few days. Market information is for general awareness only and is not investment advice.
